---
title: "Cover"
description: "The title slide that opens a presentation."
---

This page covers the `Cover` slide: what it shows, its options and the photo
variant.

## A first cover

```python
from banners import Cover, configure

configure(team="Analytics Team", date="2026")
Cover(title="Churn Prediction v2", subtitle="Model migration and deployment.")
```

![](../../images/cover-basic.png){width=80%}

The template draws a dark cover with the logo, the team at the top right, the
title, the subtitle and the date. The team and the date come from
`configure()`, so every cover of the deck shows the same ones without
repeating them.

## A cover with a photo

`image=` puts a photo behind the title. It accepts a URL, a file path or bytes:

```python
from banners import Cover

Cover(
    title="Earth observation",
    subtitle="Ten years of satellite data.",
    image="https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:FilePath/The_Earth_seen_from_Apollo_17.jpg?width=1600",
)
```

![](../../images/cover-photo.png){width=80%}

A template can set a photo for every cover with `cover_image` (`COSMOS` and
`TERRA` do). `Cover(image=False)` turns it off for one slide.

## Options

| Argument | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | — | Main title of the presentation. |
| `subtitle` | `""` | One sentence of context under the title. |
| `date` | `configure(date=...)` | Date shown at the bottom. |
| `team` | `configure(team=...)` | Team or author line. |
| `image` | the template's `cover_image` | Photo behind the title; `False` hides the template's photo. |
| `palette` | the deck's palette | Colors for this slide only. |
| `background` | `configure(background=...)` | Background of the canvas. |

`content` and `footer` exist so that every slide type accepts the same
arguments, but the cover layout does not draw them.
